title: Widget Polish, Routines & Tasks Widgets, and Campus Persistence
releaseNotes: Widget Outline & Layout Polish: Fixed outline and border clipping on schedule cards across home screen widgets.
New Routines & Tasks Widgets: Added dedicated home screen widgets for day routine alarms and scrollable tasks.
Adaptive Theme Eagle Overlay: The floating Eagle companion bubble and quick glance card now match your equipped app theme.
Permanent Campus Persistence: Resolved an issue where selected campuses reverted to default after app restarts.
Timetable Options Menu Fix: Resolved the 3-dot options dropdown on the timetable header so options open cleanly.
